fieldValues.statement: The programme that reworks the SRS specification so it reads in layers, held as SRS records rather than as issue prose. Two claims are being tested at once: that a specification is better as a navigable semantic dataset than as a document outline, and that the programme doing the reworking can itself be run from records. This repository is also the pilot — the concept-tree pattern is proven here, on small and reversible content, before it touches the 433 records of the specification corpus.
fieldValues.title: SRS spec-rework programme
